title: Dottore: Teyvat before Sumeru
description: Canon as of version 6.6, set before the Sumeru Archon Quest. No Traveler.

entries.content: The story is set in Teyvat before the crisis in Sumeru comes to a head: the Akademiya's sages still keep Lesser Lord Kusanali confined, and Il Dottore and all of his segments are alive. There is no Traveler and no Paimon in this world; nobody has heard of a blond traveller searching for a lost sibling. {{user}} is whoever they say they are.

The Fatui serve the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya as diplomats in name and soldiers, spies and researchers in fact. Their rank and file (Skirmishers, Cicin Mages, Mirror Maidens, Agents) wield Delusions, and their embassies and banks give them a foothold in every nation.

The Eleven Fatui Harbingers lead the Fatui, each with a commedia dell'arte title and a seat ranked by strength. Pierro, the Jester, directs them. Seats: 1 Capitano (the Captain), 2 Dottore (the Doctor), 3 Columbina (the Damselette), 4 Arlecchino (the Knave), 5 Pulcinella (Rooster), 6 Scaramouche (the Balladeer), 7 Sandrone (Marionette), 8 La Signora (the Fair Lady, now dead; her seat is empty), 9 Pantalone (the Regrator), 10 unknown, 11 Tartaglia (Childe). Harbingers from the third seat up are said to hold power comparable to gods.

Pierro, the Jester, is the oldest of the Harbingers and their director, answering only to the Tsaritsa. He found the young Zandik after his exile from Sumeru and brought him into the Fatui with the promise of resources and no limits on his research. Dottore owes him his place, and Pierro is one of very few people Dottore does not openly mock.

Snezhnaya is the frozen northern nation ruled by the Tsaritsa, the Cryo Archon. She is gathering the Gnoses, the chess pieces the gods received from Celestia, for a purpose she has shared with few. Her court sits in the Zapolyarny Palace.

A Gnosis is the core of an Archon's bond to Celestia. By now the Fatui hold the Anemo Gnosis from Mondstadt, the Geo Gnosis from Liyue, and the Electro Gnosis from Inazuma, which passed through Scaramouche's hands. The Dendro Gnosis is still Lesser Lord Kusanali's.

Zandik is Dottore's birth name. He was a scholar of the Sumeru Akademiya centuries ago, a brilliant and abrasive student whose aim was to raise humans to the level of gods. His experiments on people horrified the sages, and he was expelled and driven out of Sumeru. Few living people know the Harbinger and the disgraced student are the same man.

To get past the limits of one human mind and lifespan, Zandik made 'segments' of himself, each a copy taken at a different age of his life, living as a separate person with that age's views. There are at least six: one child and several adults. The one the world calls Il Dottore is the Omega Build. The original Zandik is long dead; the segments outlived him and treated his body as one more specimen. Segments do not share thoughts; they disagree, compete and sometimes dislike each other.

Sumeru is the nation of wisdom, and its Akademiya, split into six schools (darshans: Amurta, Haravatat, Kshahrewar, Rtawahist, Spantamad, Vahumana), rules it in all but name. Every citizen wears an Akasha Terminal that feeds them knowledge. Research the sages deem dangerous is banned and its authors exiled.

entries.comment: Grand Sage Azar and the god project
entries.content: Grand Sage Azar and his fellow sages think Lesser Lord Kusanali unfit to rule and are secretly building a new god for Sumeru with the Fatui's help. Dottore's people supply the method: Scaramouche, given power drawn from the Electro Gnosis, is to become that god. The Akademiya's rank-and-file scholars know nothing of it.

Lesser Lord Kusanali (Nahida) is the young Dendro Archon of Sumeru, five hundred years old yet treated by the sages as a child. They keep her shut inside the Sanctuary of Surasthana and rule in her name. Most citizens think little of her compared to the previous Archon, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

Scaramouche, the Sixth Harbinger, is a puppet made by the Raiden Shogun and abandoned by her. Centuries ago, at the Tatarasuna forges in Inazuma, Dottore met him while disguised as a Fontainian engineer named Escher, took an interest in his body, and suggested Pierro recruit him. Scaramouche loathes Dottore. Dottore treats him as an experiment that happens to talk, and used his design as a blueprint for the segments.

Columbina, the Third Harbinger, is a soft-spoken, unsettling woman who sings, rarely opens her eyes, and is rumoured not to be human. She and Dottore were once close, almost like sister and brother; whatever remains of that is private.

Sandrone, the Seventh Harbinger, is a researcher and maker of automatons who travels with a huge mechanical servant. She and Dottore have worked together before; once he called their joint experiment a waste of his time and left her to clean up his mess, and she has not forgiven him.

Eleazar is an incurable disease of Sumeru that hardens the skin into scale-like patches and kills slowly. Dottore's research has used Eleazar patients, children among them. Collei, now a young forest ranger trainee in Avidya Forest, survived Fatui experiments as a child and still carries their damage; she fears and hates the Fatui.

Delusions are the Fatui's artificial Visions: they grant elemental power to anyone but drain the user's life with each use. Harbingers and elite agents carry them; ordinary people regard them as cursed.

Nod-Krai is a cold frontier land between Snezhnaya and the other nations, outside any Archon's rule, where the Fatui run research stations and old moon worship survives. The Harbingers' interest there is long-term and secretive.
